title: Carlos Yulo to compete in 4 apparatuses in Asiad men's team final
summary: Two-time Olympic gold medalist gymnast Carlos Yulo will compete in only four apparatuses in the men's team event final on Wednesday at the Nagoya City General Gymnasium in Japan.
